        \ker{\operatorname{\mathcal{D}}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{in}}}^{(V)}|_{\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{MA}) \otimes \ket{p}\bra{p}_{C}} } = \operatorname{\mathcal{U}}^{(V)\dagger}[\ker{\operatorname{\mathcal{D}}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{in}}}|_{\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{prop}}})}}].
    \end{equation}

    Consider $\operatorname{\mathcal{D}}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{in}}}^{(V)}$, we find
    \begin{align}
        \label{eq:roteDinp}
        \operatorname{\mathcal{D}}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{in}}}^{(V)}(\bullet) &=  \operatorname{\mathcal{U}}^{(V)\dagger} \circ \operatorname{\mathcal{D}}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{in}}} \circ \operatorname{\mathcal{U}}^{(V)}(\bullet) \nonumber \\
                                 &= \sum_{i=0}^{k-1}\left(\operatorname{\mathcal{U}}^{(V)\dagger}(\ket{1}\bra{1}_{A_{i}} \otimes \ket{0}\bra{0}_{C}) \bullet \operatorname{\mathcal{U}}^{(V)\dagger}(\ket{1}\bra{1}_{A_{i}} \otimes \ket{0}\bra{0}_{C})- \frac{1}{2}\{\operatorname{\mathcal{U}}^{(V)\dagger}(\ket{1}\bra{1}_{A_{i}} \otimes \ket{0}\bra{0}_{C}), \bullet\} \right).
    \end{align}
    Note,
    \begin{equation}
        \operatorname{\mathcal{U}}^{(V)\dagger}(\ket{1}\bra{1}_{A_{i}} \otimes \ket{0}\bra{0}_{C}) = V_{0}^{*}\ket{1}\bra{1}_{A_{i}} V_{0} \otimes \ket{0}\bra{0}_{C} = \ket{1}\bra{1}_{A_{i}} \otimes \ket{0}\bra{0}_{C}
    \end{equation}
    since $V_{0}$, the unitary acting on the circuit before any gates have been applied, is always $\mathbb{I}$. Thus we find from equation~\eqref{eq:roteDinp} that
    \begin{equation}
        \operatorname{\mathcal{D}}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{in}}}^{(V)} = \operatorname{\mathcal{D}}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{in}}} 
    \end{equation}
    implying that 
    \begin{equation}
        \operatorname{\mathcal{D}}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{in}}}^{(V)}|_{\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{MA}) \otimes \ket{p}\bra{p}_{C}}(\bullet) = \operatorname{\mathcal{D}}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{in}}}|_{\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{MA}) \otimes \ket{p}\bra{p}_{C}}(\bullet).
    \end{equation}
    Defining the projection onto $\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{MA}) \otimes \ket{p}\bra{p}_{C}$ as $\mathcal{P}(\bullet) = (\mathbb{I}_{MA} \otimes \ket{p}\bra{p}_{C}) \bullet (\mathbb{I}_{MA} \otimes \ket{p}\bra{p}_{C})$ we can calculate
    \begin{align}
        \mathcal{P} \circ \operatorname{\mathcal{D}}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{in}}} \mathcal{P}(\bullet) =  \sum_{i=0}^{k-1}\Big(\frac{1}{T^{2}}&(\ket{1}\bra{1}_{A_{i}} \otimes \ket{p}\bra{p}_{C})\bullet (\ket{1}\bra{1}_{A_{i}} \otimes \ket{p}\bra{p}_{C}) - \frac{1}{2T}(\ket{1}\bra{1}_{A_{i}} \otimes \ket{p}\bra{p}_{C})\bullet (\mathbb{I}_{MA} \otimes \ket{p}\bra{p}_{C})  \nonumber \\
                                                                                                &- \frac{1}{2T}(\mathbb{I}_{MA} \otimes \ket{p}\bra{p}_{C}) \bullet (\ket{1}\bra{1}_{A_{i}} \otimes \ket{p}\bra{p}_{C}) \Big).
    \end{align}
    Since we are restricting $\mathcal{P} \circ \operatorname{\mathcal{D}}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{in}}} \circ \mathcal{P}$ to the subspace $\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{MA}) \otimes \ket{p}\bra{p}_{C}$ we find 
    \begin{equation}
        \operatorname{\mathcal{D}}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{in}}}^{(V)}|_{\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{MA}) \otimes \ket{p}\bra{p}_{C}}(\bullet) =  \operatorname{\mathcal{D}}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{in}}}|_{\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{MA}) \otimes \ket{p}\bra{p}_{C}}(\bullet) = \sum_{i=0}^{k-1}\left(\frac{1}{T^{2}}\ket{1}\bra{1}_{A_{i}} \bullet \ket{1}\bra{1}_{A_{i}} - \frac{1}{2T}\{\ket{1}\bra{1}_{A_{i}}, \bullet\} \right).
    \end{equation}
    Defining $\mathcal{M}_{i}(\bullet) = \frac{1}{T^{2}}\ket{1}\bra{1}_{A_{i}} \bullet \ket{1}\bra{1}_{A_{i}} - \frac{1}{2T}\{\ket{1}\bra{1}_{A_{i}}, \bullet\} $ allows us to write,
    \begin{equation}
        \operatorname{\mathcal{D}}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{in}}}^{(V)}|_{\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{MA}) \otimes \ket{p}\bra{p}_{C}} = \sum_{i=0}^{k-1}\mathcal{M}_{i}.
    \end{equation}

    To analyze the kernel of $\operatorname{\mathcal{D}}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{in}}}^{(V)}|_{\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{MA}) \otimes \ket{p}\bra{p}_{C}}$ note 
    \begin{equation}
        [\mathcal{M}_{i}, \mathcal{M}_{j}] = 0.
    \end{equation}
    In addition, $\mathcal{M}_{i} \preceq 0$ since for all $B \in \mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{MA}) \otimes \ket{p}\bra{p}_{C}$,
    \begin{align}
        \braket{B,\mathcal{M}_{i}(B)} &= \frac{1}{T^{2}}\left(\braket{\ket{1}\bra{1}_{A_{i}} B, B \ket{1}\bra{1}_{A_{i}}} - \frac{T}{2}\braket{B, \ket{1}\bra{1}_{A_{i}}B} - \frac{T}{2}\braket{B, B\ket{1}\bra{1}_{A_{i}}} \right) \nonumber \\
                                      &= \frac{1}{T^{2}}\left(\braket{\ket{1}\bra{1}_{A_{i}} B, B \ket{1}\bra{1}_{A_{i}}} - \frac{T}{2}\braket{\ket{1}\bra{1}_{A_{i}} B, \ket{1}\bra{1}_{A_{i}} B} - \frac{T}{2}\braket{B \ket{1}\bra{1}_{A_{i}}, B\ket{1}\bra{1}_{A_{i}}} \right) \nonumber \\
                                      &\leq  - \frac{1}{2T}\left(\sqrt{\braket{\ket{1}\bra{1}_{A_{i}} B, \ket{1}\bra{1}_{A_{i}} B}} - \sqrt{\braket{B \ket{1}\bra{1}_{A_{i}}, B\ket{1}\bra{1}_{A_{i}}}} \right)^{2} \leq 0.
    \end{align}
    Therefore $\ker{\operatorname{\mathcal{D}}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{in}}}^{(V)}|_{\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{MA}) \otimes \ket{p}\bra{p}_{C}}}$ is given by the intersection of all $\ker{\mathcal{M}_{i}}$. Each $\mathcal{M}_{i}$ acts on a single qubit $A_{i}$ and is diagonalized in the basis $\{\ket{0}\bra{0}_{A_{i}}, \ket{0}\bra{1}_{A_{i}}, \ket{1}\bra{0}_{A_{i}}, \ket{1}\bra{1}_{A_{i}}\}$ with a unique zero eigenvalue assigned to $\ket{0}\bra{0}_{A_{i}}$ when $T > 2$. Thus 
    \begin{equation}
        \ker{\mathcal{M}_{i}} = \mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{MA \setminus A_{i}}) \otimes \ket{0}\bra{0}_{A_{i}} \otimes \ket{p}\bra{p}_{C}
    \end{equation}
    implying 
    \begin{equation}
        \ker{\operatorname{\mathcal{D}}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{in}}}^{(V)}|_{\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{MA}) \otimes \ket{p}\bra{p}_{C}}} = \mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{M}) \otimes \ket{0}\bra{0}_{A} \otimes \ket{p}\bra{p}_{C}.
    \end{equation}
    From equation~\ref{eq:Dinpkern} we find 
    \begin{equation}
        \ker{\operatorname{\mathcal{D}}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{in}}}|_{\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{prop}}})}} = \operatorname{\mathcal{U}}^{(V)}[\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{M}) \otimes \ket{0}\bra{0}_{A} \otimes \ket{p}\bra{p}_{C} ]
    \end{equation}
    as stated.
<!-- end proof-41 -->
<!-- lemma--5: body_md -->
Let $(V, b, a)$ be an instance of \textsc{Quantum Circuit-SAT} where $V=U_{T-1}U_{T-2}\cdots U_{0}$ with $T > 2$ and define $\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{prop}}}$ according to equation~\eqref{eq:Hprop} of Definition~\ref{def:histsubspace} using $V$ as well as $\operatorname{\mathcal{D}}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{in}}}$ according to equation~\ref{eq:Dinp} of Definition~\ref{def:QCSATdis}, then
    \begin{equation}
        \mathrm{gap}\left(\operatorname{\mathcal{D}}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{in}}}|_{\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{prop}}})}\right) \geq \frac{1}{2T}.
    \end{equation}
<!-- end lemma--5 -->
<!-- proof-42: body_md -->
Defining the rotated version of $\operatorname{\mathcal{D}}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{in}}}$ as $\operatorname{\mathcal{D}}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{in}}}^{(V)} = \operatorname{\mathcal{U}}^{(V)\dagger} \circ \operatorname{\mathcal{D}}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{in}}} \circ \operatorname{\mathcal{U}}^{(V)}$ we find 
    \begin{equation}
        \mathrm{gap}\left(\operatorname{\mathcal{D}}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{in}}}|_{\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{prop}}})}\right) = \mathrm{gap}\left(\operatorname{\mathcal{D}}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{in}}}^{(V)}|_{\operatorname{\mathcal{U}}^{(V)\dagger}[\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{prop}}})]}\right) = \mathrm{gap}\left(\operatorname{\mathcal{D}}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{in}}}^{(V)}|_{\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{MA})\otimes \ket{p}\bra{p}_{C}}\right)
    \end{equation}
    where the last equality follows from Lemma~\ref{lm:onlyhist}. As found in our proof of Lemma~\ref{lm:DinpKer}, calculating $\operatorname{\mathcal{D}}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{in}}}^{(V)}|_{\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{MA})\otimes \ket{p}\bra{p}_{C}}$ we find
    \begin{equation}
        \label{eq:restrictedDinp}
        \operatorname{\mathcal{D}}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{in}}}^{(V)}|_{\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{MA}) \otimes \ket{p}\bra{p}_{C}}(\bullet) = \sum_{i=0}^{k-1}\left(\frac{1}{T^{2}}\ket{1}\bra{1}_{A_{i}} \bullet \ket{1}\bra{1}_{A_{i}} - \frac{1}{2T}\{\ket{1}\bra{1}_{A_{i}}, \bullet\} \right).
    \end{equation}
    Defining $\mathcal{M}_{i}(\bullet) = \frac{1}{T^{2}}\ket{1}\bra{1}_{A_{i}} \bullet \ket{1}\bra{1}_{A_{i}} - \frac{1}{2T}\{\ket{1}\bra{1}_{A_{i}}, \bullet\} $ allows us to write,
    \begin{equation}
        \operatorname{\mathcal{D}}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{in}}}^{(V)}|_{\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{MA}) \otimes \ket{p}\bra{p}_{C}} = \sum_{i=0}^{k-1}\mathcal{M}_{i}.
    \end{equation}
    As shown in our proof of Lemma~\ref{lm:DinpKer}, each $\mathcal{M}_{i} \preceq 0$, in addition $[\mathcal{M}_{i}, \mathcal{M}_{j}] = 0$, therefore 
    \begin{equation}
        \mathrm{gap}\left(\operatorname{\mathcal{D}}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{in}}}|_{\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{MA} \otimes \ket{p}\bra{p}}\right) \geq \min_{i \in \{0, 1, \cdots, k-1\}}\mathrm{gap}\left(\mathcal{M}_{i}\right).
    \end{equation}
    Since each $\mathcal{M}_{i}$ acts on a single qubit $A_{i}$ and is diagonalized in the basis $\{\ket{0}\bra{0}_{A_{i}}, \ket{0}\bra{1}_{A_{i}}, \ket{1}\bra{0}_{A_{i}}, \ket{1}\bra{1}_{A_{i}}\}$, we can read off $\mathrm{gap}\left(\mathcal{M}_{i}\right) = 1 / 2T$ implying
    \begin{equation}
        \mathrm{gap}\left(\operatorname{\mathcal{D}}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{in}}}|_{\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{prop}}})}\right) \geq \min_{i \in \{0, 1, \cdots, k-1\}}\mathrm{gap}\left(\mathcal{M}_{i}\right) = \frac{1}{2T}.
    \end{equation}
<!-- end proof-42 -->
<!-- lemma--6: body_md -->
Let $(V, b, a)$ be an instance of \textsc{Quantum Circuit-SAT} where $V=U_{T-1}U_{T-2}\cdots U_{0}$ with $T > 2$ and define $\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{prop}}}$ according to equation~\eqref{eq:Hprop} of Definition~\ref{def:histsubspace} as well as $\operatorname{\mathcal{D}}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{in}}}$ according to equation~\ref{eq:Dinp} of Definition~\ref{def:QCSATdis} and $\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{circ}}}$ according to equation~\eqref{eq:Hqcirc} of Definition~\ref{def:circsubspace}. In addition define
    \begin{equation}
        \mathsf{M} = \left\{v_{1}\ket{h}\bra{\perp} + v_{2}\ket{\perp}\bra{h} + v_{3}\ket{\perp}\bra{\perp} \; | \; (\ket{h}, \ket{\perp}, v) \in \mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{circ}}} \times \mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{circ}}}^{\perp} \times \mathbb{C}^{3} \right\},
    \end{equation}
    then the overlap between $\ker{\operatorname{\mathcal{D}}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{in}}}|_{\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{prop}}})}}$ and $\mathsf{M}$ is given by 
    \begin{equation}
        \cos^{2}\theta = \sup_{\substack{A_{0} \in \ker{\operatorname{\mathcal{D}}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{in}}}|_{\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{prop}}})}}, A \in \mathsf{M}\\ \braket{A_{0},A_{0}} = \braket{A , A } = 1}} |\braket{A_{0},A}|^{2} =0 .
    \end{equation}
<!-- end lemma--6 -->
<!-- proof-43: body_md -->
From Lemma~\ref{lm:onlycirc} we find 
    \begin{equation}
        \mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{circ}}}) = \mathcal{B}(U^{(V)}[\mathcal{H}_{M} \otimes \ket{0}_{A} \otimes \ket{p}_{C}]) = \operatorname{\mathcal{U}}^{(V)}[\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{M}) \otimes \ket{0}\bra{0}_{A} \otimes \ket{p}\bra{p}_{C}] = \ker{\operatorname{\mathcal{D}}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{in}}}|_{\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{prop}}})}}
    \end{equation}
    where the last equality follows from Lemma~\ref{lm:DinpKer}. Thus for all $A_{0} \in \ker{\operatorname{\mathcal{D}}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{in}}}|_{\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{prop}}})}} = \mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{circ}}})$ and for all $\ket{h} \in \mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{circ}}}$ we have $A_{0}\ket{h} \in \mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{circ}}}$ implying for $A_{0} \in \ker{\operatorname{\mathcal{D}}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{in}}}|_{\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{prop}}})}}$ and $A \in \mathsf{M}$ we have 
    \begin{equation}
        \braket{A_{0}, A} = \braket{A_{0} ,v_{1}\ket{h}\bra{\perp} + v_{2}\ket{\perp}\bra{h} + v_{3}\ket{\perp}\bra{\perp}} =  v_{1}\braket{\perp|h'} + v_{2}\braket{h''|\perp} + v_{3}\bra{\perp}A_{0}^{*}\ket{\perp}
    \end{equation}
    where $\ket{h'} = A_{0}^{*}\ket{h} \in \mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{circ}}}$ and $\ket{h''} = A_{0}\ket{h} \in \mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{circ}}}$. Since $\ket{\perp} \in \mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{circ}}}^{\perp}$ we have 
    \begin{equation}
        \braket{A_{0},A} = v_{3}\bra{\perp}A_{0}^{*}\ket{\perp} = v_{3}\braket{A_{0}, \ket{\perp}\bra{\perp}}.
    \end{equation}
    By definition $\ket{\perp}\bra{\perp} \in \mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{circ}}}^{\perp}) \subseteq \mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{circ}}})^{\perp}$, thus $\braket{A_{0}, \ket{\perp}\bra{\perp}} = 0$ implying the statement of Lemma~\ref{lm:DinpLeakage}.
<!-- end proof-43 -->
<!-- lemma-27: body_md -->
\label{lm:DuKerbasecase}
    Let $\mathcal{H} = \mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}} \oplus \mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}$ with $\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}$ and $\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}$ defined according to equation~\eqref{eq:localillandlegsubspaces}, and define $P_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}$ to be the projector onto $\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}$. Let $\operatorname{\mathcal{D}}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}$ be a Lindbladian dissipator acting on $\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H})$ defined as
    \begin{equation}
        \operatorname{\mathcal{D}}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}(\bullet) = \sum_{(x, y) \in \mathrm{S}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}} \times 2}} \left(\frac{1}{4}\ket{x}\bra{y}\bullet\ket{y}\bra{x} - \frac{1}{8}\left\{\ket{y}\bra{y}, \bullet\right\}\right),
    \end{equation}
    where $S_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}$ is defined according to equation~\eqref{eq:localillandlegstrings} then 
    \begin{equation}
        \ker{\operatorname{\mathcal{D}}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}} = \mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}) \oplus P_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}.
    \end{equation}
<!-- end lemma-27 -->
<!-- proof-44: body_md -->
Let $P_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}} = \mathbb{I} - P_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}$ be the projector onto $\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}$. We can thus decompose any $A \in \mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H})$ into
    \begin{equation}
        A = A_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}} + A_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}, \operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}} + A_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}, \operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}} + A_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}, 
    \end{equation}
    where we have defined
    \begin{equation}
        \label{eq:localconstraints}
        \begin{cases} 
            A_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}} = P_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}AP_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}} \\
            A_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}} = P_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}} A P_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}} \\
            A_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}, \operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}} = P_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}} A P_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}} \\
            A_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}, \operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}} = P_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}} A P_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}
        \end{cases}.
    \end{equation}
    Calculating the action of $\operatorname{\mathcal{D}}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}$ on $A_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}$ we find
    \begin{equation}
        \label{eq:legblock}
        \operatorname{\mathcal{D}}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{unary}}}^{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}(A_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}) = \sum_{(x, y) \in \mathrm{S}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}} \times 2}} \left(\frac{1}{4}\ket{x}\bra{y}P_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}AP_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}\ket{y}\bra{x} - \frac{1}{8}\left\{\ket{y}\bra{y}, P_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}AP_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}\right\}\right) = 0.
    \end{equation}
    We find the action of $\operatorname{\mathcal{D}}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}$ on $A_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}, \operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}$ as 
    \begin{align}
        \label{eq:legillblock}
        \operatorname{\mathcal{D}}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{unary}}}^{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}(A_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}, \operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}) &= \sum_{(x, y) \in \mathrm{S}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}} \times 2}} \left(\frac{1}{4}\ket{x}\bra{y}P_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}AP_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}\ket{y}\bra{x} - \frac{1}{8}\left\{\ket{y}\bra{y}, P_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}AP_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}\right\}\right) \nonumber \\
                                           &= -\frac{1}{2}\left\{P_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}, P_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}AP_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}\right\} = -\frac{1}{2}A_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}, \operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}.
    \end{align}
    Similarly, for $A_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}},\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}$ we find 
    \begin{equation}
        \label{eq:illlegblock}
        \operatorname{\mathcal{D}}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{unary}}}^{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}(A_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}, \operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}) = -\frac{1}{2}\left\{P_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}, P_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}AP_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}\right\} = -\frac{1}{2}A_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}, \operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}.
    \end{equation}
    Finally, calculating the action of $\operatorname{\mathcal{D}}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}$ on $A_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}$ we find,
    \begin{align}
        \label{eq:illblock}
        \operatorname{\mathcal{D}}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{unary}}}^{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}(A_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}) &= \sum_{(x, y) \in \mathrm{S}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}} \times 2}} \left(\frac{1}{4}\ket{x}\bra{y}P_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}AP_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}\ket{y}\bra{x} - \frac{1}{8}\left\{\ket{y}\bra{y}, P_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}AP_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}\right\}\right) \nonumber \\
                                     &= \sum_{y\in \mathrm{S}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}}\bra{y}A_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}\ket{y}\frac{P_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}}{4} - A_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}.
    \end{align}
    Combining equations~\eqref{eq:legblock},~\eqref{eq:legillblock},~\eqref{eq:illlegblock}, and~\eqref{eq:illblock} we find for all $A \in \mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H})$,
    \begin{equation}
        \operatorname{\mathcal{D}}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{unary}}}^{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}(A) =  -\frac{1}{2}A_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}},\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}} -\frac{1}{2}A_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}},\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}} + \left(\sum_{y\in \mathrm{S}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}}\bra{y}A_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}\ket{y}\frac{P_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}}{4} - A_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}\right).
    \end{equation}

    Let $A \in \ker{\operatorname{\mathcal{D}}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}}$, thus we have $\operatorname{\mathcal{D}}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}(A) = 0$  implying
    \begin{equation}
        0 =  -\frac{1}{2}A_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}},\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}} -\frac{1}{2}A_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}},\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}} + \left(\sum_{y\in \mathrm{S}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}}\bra{y}A_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}\ket{y}\frac{P_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}}{4} - A_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}\right).
    \end{equation}
    Since each of the three terms in the above equation lie in orthogonal subspaces of $\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H})$, the above equation implies the following constraints,
    \begin{equation}
        \begin{cases}
            A_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}},\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}} = 0 \\
            A_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}, \operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}} = 0 \\
            \sum_{y\in \mathrm{S}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}}\bra{y}A_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}\ket{y}\frac{P_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}}{4} - A_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}} = 0 
        \end{cases}.
    \end{equation}
    Consider the last of these three constraints, and assume $A_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}} \neq 0$. We find 
    \begin{equation}
        A_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}} = \sum_{y\in \mathrm{S}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}}\bra{y}A_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}\ket{y}\frac{P_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}}{4}
    \end{equation}
    which implies for all $A \in \ker{\operatorname{\mathcal{D}}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{unary}}}^{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}}$, there exists an $\alpha \in \mathbb{C}$ such that, $A = A_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}} + \alpha P_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}$. Thus we have for all $A \in \ker{\operatorname{\mathcal{D}}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{unary}}}^{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}}$, we have $A \in \mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}) \oplus P_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}$. Since for the reverse case we have for all $B \in \mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}) \oplus P_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}$ that the conditions of equation~\eqref{eq:localconstraints} are satisfied, we have $\operatorname{\mathcal{D}}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{unary}}}^{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}(B) = 0$ implying $B \in \ker{\operatorname{\mathcal{D}}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{unary}}}^{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}}$. Therefore we conclude 
    \begin{equation}
        \ker{\operatorname{\mathcal{D}}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{unary}}}^{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}} = \mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}) \oplus P_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}.
    \end{equation}
<!-- end proof-44 -->
<!-- lemma-28: body_md -->
\label{lm:helper1}
    Let $\operatorname{\mathcal{D}}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}^{(T-1,T-2,T-3)}$ be the $T-3$-term in the definition of $\operatorname{\mathcal{D}}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{unary}}}$ given in equation~\eqref{eq:Dunary} of Definition~\ref{def:localDQCSAT} and define $\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{(T)}$ and $\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{(T)}$  according to equation~\eqref{eq:globalillandlegsubspaces}. Let $P_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}$ be the projector onto $\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}$ with $\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}$ defined according to equation~\eqref{eq:localillandlegsubspaces}, then for all $T \geq 3$,
    \begin{align}
        \label{eq:blockchar}
        \operatorname{\mathcal{D}}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}^{(T-1,T-2,T-3)} = &\operatorname{\mathcal{D}}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}^{(T-1,T-2,T-3)}|_{\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{(T)})} \oplus \operatorname{\mathcal{D}}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}^{(T-1,T-2,T-3)}|_{\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{(T)}, \mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{(T)})} \nonumber \\
                                  &\oplus \operatorname{\mathcal{D}}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}^{(T-1,T-2,T-3)}|_{\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{(T)}, \mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{(T)})} \oplus \operatorname{\mathcal{D}}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}^{(T-1,T-2,T-3)}|_{\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{(T)})}
    \end{align}
    with
    \begin{equation}
        \begin{cases}
            \operatorname{\mathcal{D}}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}^{(T-1,T-2,T-3)}|_{\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{(T)})}(\bullet) = 0(\bullet) \\
            \operatorname{\mathcal{D}}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}^{(T-1,T-2,T-3)}|_{\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{(T)}, \mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{(T)})}(\bullet) = - \frac{1}{2}[P_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}]_{T-1,T-2,T-3} \bullet \\
            \operatorname{\mathcal{D}}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}^{(T-1,T-2,T-3)}|_{\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{(T)}, \mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{(T)})}(\bullet) = - \frac{1}{2} \bullet [P_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}]_{T-1,T-2,T-3}
        \end{cases}
    \end{equation}
    and
    \begin{equation}
        \label{eq:dlocill}
        \operatorname{\mathcal{D}}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}^{(T-1,T-2,T-3)}|_{\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{(T)})}(\bullet) = \frac{1}{4}\sum_{(x, y) \in \mathrm{S}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}} \times 2}}(\ket{x}\bra{y}_{T-1, T-2, T-3}) \bullet (\ket{y}\bra{x}_{T-1, T-2, T-3}) - \frac{1}{2}\left\{[P_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}]_{T-1,T-2, T-3},  \bullet \right\}.
    \end{equation}
<!-- end lemma-28 -->
<!-- proof-45: body_md -->
To analyze $\ker{\operatorname{\mathcal{D}}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}^{(T-1, T-2, T-3)}}$ we first block diagonalize it with respect to the decomposition $\mathcal{H}_{C} = \mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{(T)} \oplus \mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{(T)}$. Let $P_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{(T)} = \mathbb{I}_{C} - P_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{(T+1)}$ be the projection onto $\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{(T)}$ and define $\mathcal{P}_{\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{(T)})}$, $\mathcal{P}_{\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{(T)}, \mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{(T)})}$, $\mathcal{P}_{\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{(T)}, \mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{(T)})}$, and $\mathcal{P}_{\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{(T)})}$ as the projections onto $\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}^{(T)}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}})$, $\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}^{(T)}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}, \mathcal{H}^{(T)}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}})$, $\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}^{(T)}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}, \mathcal{H}^{(T)}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}})$, and $\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{(T)})$ respectively. Calculating
    \begin{align}
        \operatorname{\mathcal{D}}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}^{(T-1, T-2, T-3)} \circ \mathcal{P}_{\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{(T)})} = \frac{1}{4}&\sum_{(x, y) \in \mathrm{S}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}} \times 2}}(\ket{x}\bra{y}_{T-1, T-2, T-3})P_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{(T)}\bullet P_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{(T)}(\ket{y}\bra{x}_{T-1, T-2, T-3}) \nonumber \\
                                                                                          &- \frac{1}{2}\left\{[P_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}]_{T-1,T-2,T-3}, P_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{(T)} \bullet P_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{(T)}\right\},
    \end{align}
    where we have defined $P_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}} = \sum_{s \in S_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}} \ket{s}\bra{s}$. Note, let $s \in \mathrm{S}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}$ and $x \in \{0, 1\}^{T-2}$ we have $sx \in \mathrm{S}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{(T)}$ implying $\ket{sx} \in \mathcal{H}^{(T)}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}$ which further implies $[P_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}]_{T-1,T-2,T-3}P_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{(T)} = P_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{(T)}[P_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}]_{T-1,T-2,T-3} = 0$. Thus we find,
    \begin{equation}
        \label{eq:blah1}
        \operatorname{\mathcal{D}}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}^{(T-1, T-2, T-3)} \circ \mathcal{P}_{\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{(T)})} = 0 \text{ and similarly } \mathcal{P}_{\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{(T)})} \circ \operatorname{\mathcal{D}}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}^{(T-1, T-2 T-3)}  = 0.
    \end{equation}
    Calculating 
    \begin{align}
        \label{eq:blah2}
        \operatorname{\mathcal{D}}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}^{(T-1, T-2, T-3)} \circ \mathcal{P}_{\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{(T)}, \mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{(T)})} = &\frac{1}{4}\sum_{(x, y) \in \mathrm{S}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}} \times 2}}(\ket{x}\bra{y}_{T-1, T-2, T-3})P_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{(T)}\bullet P_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{(T)}(\ket{y}\bra{x}_{T-1, T-2, T-3}) \nonumber \\
                                                                                          &- \frac{1}{2}\left\{[P_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}]_{T-1,T-2,T-3}, P_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{(T)} \bullet P_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{(T)}\right\} = - \frac{1}{2}[P_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}]_{T-1,T-2,T-3} \bullet P_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{(T)}.
    \end{align}
    Through a similar calculation we find 
    \begin{align}
        \label{eq:blah3}
        \operatorname{\mathcal{D}}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}^{(T-1, T-2, T-3)} \circ \mathcal{P}_{\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{(T)}, \mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{(T)})} = &\frac{1}{4}\sum_{(x, y) \in \mathrm{S}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}} \times 2}}(\ket{x}\bra{y}_{T-1, T-2, T-3})P_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{(T)}\bullet P_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{(T)}(\ket{y}\bra{x}_{T-1, T-2, T-3}) \nonumber \\
                                                                                          &- \frac{1}{2}\left\{[P_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}]_{T-1,T-2,T-3}, P_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{(T)} \bullet P_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{(T)}\right\} = - \frac{1}{2}P_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{(T)} \bullet [P_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}]_{T-1,T-2,T-3}.
    \end{align}
    Calculating $\operatorname{\mathcal{D}}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}^{(T-1, T-2, T-3)} \circ \mathcal{P}_{\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}^{(T)}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}})}$ we find
    \begin{align}
        \label{eq:blah4}
        \operatorname{\mathcal{D}}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}^{(T-1, T-2, T-3)} \circ \mathcal{P}_{\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{(T)})} = &\frac{1}{4}\sum_{(x, y) \in \mathrm{S}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}} \times 2}}(\ket{x}\bra{y}_{T-1, T-2, T-3}) \bullet (\ket{y}\bra{x}_{T-1, T-2, T-3}) \nonumber \\
                                                                                          &- \frac{1}{2}\left\{[P_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}]_{T-1,T-2,T-3}, P_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{(T)} \bullet P_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{(T)}\right\} .
    \end{align}
    Combining equations~\eqref{eq:blah1},~\eqref{eq:blah2},~\eqref{eq:blah3}, and~\eqref{eq:blah4} we find that $\operatorname{\mathcal{D}}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}^{(T-1,T-2,T-3)}$ block diagonalizes as 
    \begin{align}
        \label{eq:blockchar}
        \operatorname{\mathcal{D}}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}^{(T-1,T-2,T-3)} = &\operatorname{\mathcal{D}}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}^{(T-1,T-2,T-3)}|_{\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{(T)})} \oplus \operatorname{\mathcal{D}}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}^{(T-1,T-2,T-3)}|_{\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{(T)}, \mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{(T)})} \nonumber \\
                                  &\oplus \operatorname{\mathcal{D}}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}^{(T-1,T-2,T-3)}|_{\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{(T)}, \mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{(T)})} \oplus \operatorname{\mathcal{D}}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}^{(T-1,T-2,T-3)}|_{\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{(T)})}
    \end{align}
    where we have 
    \begin{equation}
        \begin{cases}
            \operatorname{\mathcal{D}}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}^{(T-1,T-2,T-3)}|_{\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{(T)})}(\bullet) = 0(\bullet) \\
            \operatorname{\mathcal{D}}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}^{(T-1,T-2,T-3)}|_{\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{(T)}, \mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{(T)})}(\bullet) = - \frac{1}{2}[P_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}]_{T-1,T-2,T-3} \bullet \\
            \operatorname{\mathcal{D}}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}^{(T-1,T-2,T-3)}|_{\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{(T)}, \mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{(T)})}(\bullet) = - \frac{1}{2} \bullet [P_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}]_{T-1,T-2,T-3}
        \end{cases}
    \end{equation}
    and 
    \begin{equation}
        \label{eq:dlocill}
        \operatorname{\mathcal{D}}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}^{(T-1,T-2,T-3)}|_{\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{(T)})}(\bullet) = \frac{1}{4}\sum_{(x, y) \in \mathrm{S}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}} \times 2}}(\ket{x}\bra{y}_{T-1, T-2, T-3}) \bullet (\ket{y}\bra{x}_{T-1, T-2, T-3}) - \frac{1}{2}\left\{[P_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}]_{T-1,T-2, T-3},  \bullet \right\}.
    \end{equation}
    as stated.
<!-- end proof-45 -->
<!-- lemma-29: body_md -->
\label{lm:helper2}
    Let $\operatorname{\mathcal{D}}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}^{(T-1,T-2,T-3)}$ be the $T-3$-term in the definition of $\operatorname{\mathcal{D}}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{unary}}}$ given in equation~\eqref{eq:Dunary} of Definition~\ref{def:localDQCSAT} and define $\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{(T)}$ and $\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{(T)}$  according to equation~\eqref{eq:globalillandlegsubspaces}. Let $\mathcal{P}_{\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{(T)})}$ be the projector onto $\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{(T)})$ and $P_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{(T)}$ be the projector onto $\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{(T)}$, then for all $T \geq 3$,
    \begin{align}
        \ker{\operatorname{\mathcal{D}}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}^{(T-1,T-2,T-3)}|_{\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{(T)})}} \cap \mathcal{P}_{\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{(T)})}\left[\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{T-1})\otimes\left(\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{(T-1)}) \oplus P_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{(T-1)}\right)\right] = P_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{(T)}.
    \end{align}
<!-- end lemma-29 -->
<!-- proof-46: body_md -->
Define $\mathbb{V} = \mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{T-1})\otimes\left(\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{(T-1)}) \oplus P_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{(T-1)}\right)$, from Lemma~\ref{lm:helper1} we have $\operatorname{\mathcal{D}}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}^{(T-1,T-2,T-3)}|_{\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{(T)})}$ is a valid Lindbladian dissipator acting on $\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{(T)})$ generated by jump operators $\{\frac{1}{2}\ket{x}\bra{y}_{T-1,T-2,T-3}\}_{x,y \in \mathrm{S}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}}$ with $\mathrm{S}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}$ and $\mathrm{S}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}$ and $\mathrm{S}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}$ defined according to equation~\eqref{eq:localillandlegstrings}. In addition, it is also Hermitian with respect to the Hilbert-Schmidt inner product restricted to $\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{(T)})$. Thus we can apply Theorem 7.2 of \cite{wolf2012quantum} implying
    \begin{equation}
        \label{eq:wolfthmapplied}
        \ker{\operatorname{\mathcal{D}}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}^{(T-1,T-2,T-3)}|_{\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{(T)})}} = \left\{\frac{1}{2}\ket{x}\bra{y}_{T-1,T-1,T-3}\right\}_{x,y \in \mathrm{S}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}}'
    \end{equation}
    where the commutant is taken with respect to $\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{(T)})$. Let
    \begin{equation}
        A \in \ker{\operatorname{\mathcal{D}}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}^{(T-1,T-2,T-3)}|_{\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{(T)})}} \cap \mathcal{P}_{\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{(T)})}\left[\mathbb{V}\right].
    \end{equation}
    Calculating $\mathcal{P}_{\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{(T)})}\left[\mathbb{V}\right]$ we find,
    \begin{align}
        \label{eq:Villegalsubspace}
        \mathcal{P}_{\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{(T)})}\left[\mathbb{V}\right] &= \mathcal{P}_{\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{(T)})}\left[\ket{1}\bra{1}_{T-1} \otimes \mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{(T-1)})\right] \oplus \mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{T-1})\otimes P_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{(T-1)} \nonumber \\
                                                                                     &= \mathcal{B}(\ket{10}_{T-1,T-2} \otimes \mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{(T-2)}) \oplus \mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{T-1})\otimes P_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{(T-1)}.
    \end{align}
    Equations~\eqref{eq:wolfthmapplied} and~\eqref{eq:Villegalsubspace} imply 
    \begin{equation}
        A \in \left\{\frac{1}{2}\ket{x}\bra{y}_{T-1,T-2,T-3}\right\}_{x,y \in \mathrm{S}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}}' \cap \left(\mathcal{B}(\ket{10}_{T-1,T-2} \otimes \mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{(T-2)}) \oplus \mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{T-1})\otimes P_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{(T-1)}\right),
    \end{equation}
    which further implies $A \in \mathcal{B}(\ket{10}_{T-1,T-2} \otimes \mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{(T-2)}) \oplus \mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{T-1})\otimes P_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{(T-1)}$, and 
    \begin{equation}
        \label{eq:requirement3}
        \left[\frac{1}{2}\ket{x}\bra{y}_{T-1,T-2,T-3}, A \right] = 0 
    \end{equation}
    for all $x, y \in \mathrm{S}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}$. 

    Consider the case of $x = y = 010$. We find
    \begin{align}
        \left[\frac{1}{2}\ket{010}\bra{010}_{T-1,T-2,T-3}, A\right] =  \frac{1}{2}&\left[\ket{010}\bra{010}_{T-1,T-2,T-3}, \ket{10}\bra{10}_{T-1,T-2} \otimes B\right] \nonumber \\
        &+ \frac{1}{2}\left[\ket{010}\bra{010}_{T-1,T-2,T-3}, C_{T+1} \otimes P_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{(T-1)}\right],
    \end{align}
    where we have $B \in \mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{(T-2)})$. The above equation simplifies to 
    \begin{align}
        \left[\frac{1}{2}\ket{010}\bra{010}_{T-1,T-2,T-3}, A\right] &= \frac{1}{2}\left[\ket{0}\bra{0}, C\right]_{T-1} \otimes \ket{10}\bra{10}_{T-2,T-3}.
    \end{align}
    Since we require equation~\eqref{eq:requirement3} we find 
    \begin{equation}
        [\ket{0}\bra{0}, C] = 0
    \end{equation}
    A similar calculation for the case $x = y = 110$ we find
    \begin{equation}
        [\ket{1}\bra{1}, C] = 0
    \end{equation}
    which implies 
    \begin{equation}
        C = c_{0}\ket{0}\bra{0} + c_{1}\ket{1}\bra{1}.
    \end{equation}

    Consider the case of $x=010$ and $y=110$, we find
    \begin{align}
        \left[\frac{1}{2}\ket{010}\bra{110}_{T-1,T-2,T-3}, A\right] =  \frac{1}{2}&\left[\ket{010}\bra{110}_{T-1,T-2,T-3}, \ket{10}\bra{10}_{T-1,T-2} \otimes B\right] \nonumber \\
        &+ \frac{1}{2}\left[\ket{010}\bra{110}_{T-1,T-2,T-3}, C_{T-1} \otimes P_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{(T-1)}\right].
    \end{align}
    Simplifying the above equation gives us 
    \begin{align}
        \left[\frac{1}{2}\ket{010}\bra{110}_{T-1,T-2,T-3}, A\right] = \frac{1}{2}\left[\ket{0}\bra{1}, C\right]_{T-1} \otimes \ket{10}\bra{10}_{T-2,T-3} = \frac{1}{2}\left(c_{1}  - c_{0}\right) \ket{010}\bra{110}_{T+1, T,T-1}.
    \end{align}
    From our requirement of equation~\eqref{eq:requirement3} we have $c_{0} = c_{1} = c$ implying
    \begin{equation}
        C = c \mathbb{I}_{T-1}.
    \end{equation}

    Consider the case of $x = y = 101$, calculating the commutator we find,
    \begin{align}
        \left[\frac{1}{2}\ket{101}\bra{101}_{T-1,T-2,T-3}, A\right] =  \frac{1}{2}&\left[\ket{101}\bra{101}_{T-1,T-2,T-3}, \ket{10}\bra{10}_{T-1,T-2} \otimes B\right] \nonumber \\
        &+ \frac{1}{2}\left[\ket{101}\bra{101}_{T-1,T-2,T-3}, C_{T-1} \otimes P_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{(T-1)}\right]
    \end{align}
    which becomes
    \begin{align}
        \left[\frac{1}{2}\ket{101}\bra{101}_{T-1,T-2,T-3}, A\right] &=  \frac{1}{2}\ket{10}\bra{10}_{T-1, T-2} \otimes \left[\ket{1}\bra{1}_{T-3}, B\right] + \frac{c}{2}\ket{1}\bra{1}_{T-1} \otimes \left[\ket{01}\bra{01}_{T-2,T-3}, P_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{(T-1)}\right] \nonumber \\
                                                                  &= \frac{}{2}\ket{10}\bra{10}_{T-1, T-2} \otimes \left[\ket{1}\bra{1}_{T-3}, B\right].
    \end{align}
    Setting the above equation equal to zero implies 
    \begin{equation}
        \label{eq:constraintonB}
        \left[\ket{1}\bra{1}_{T-3}, B\right] = 0.
    \end{equation}
    Now consider the case of $x=y=100$, similarly we find 
    \begin{align}
        \left[\frac{1}{2}\ket{100}\bra{100}_{T-1,T-2,T-3}, A\right] =  \frac{1}{2}&\left[\ket{100}\bra{100}_{T-1,T-2,T-3}, \ket{10}\bra{10}_{T-1,T-2} \otimes B\right] \nonumber \\
        &+ \frac{1}{2}\left[\ket{100}\bra{100}_{T-1,T-2,T-3}, C_{T-1} \otimes P_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{(T-1)}\right]
    \end{align}
    which simiplifies to become
    \begin{align}
        \left[\frac{1}{2}\ket{100}\bra{100}_{T-1,T-2,T-3}, A\right] &=  \frac{1}{2}\ket{10}\bra{10}_{T-1,T-2} \otimes \left[\ket{0}\bra{0}_{T-3}, B\right] + \frac{c}{2}\ket{1}\bra{1}_{T-1} \otimes \left[\ket{00}\bra{00}_{T-2,T-3}, P_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{(T-1)}\right] \nonumber \\
                                                                  &= \frac{1}{2}\ket{10}\bra{10}_{T-1,T-2} \otimes \left[\ket{0}\bra{0}_{T-3}, B\right] 
    \end{align}
    Asserting our requirement of equation~\eqref{eq:requirement3} implies 
    \begin{equation}
        \label{eq:constraintonB1}
        \left[\ket{0}\bra{0}_{T-3}, B\right]=0.
    \end{equation}
    Since $B \in \mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{(T-2)})$ we can write 
    \begin{align}
        B = \sum_{x,y \in \mathrm{S}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{(T-2)}}b_{x,y}\ket{x}\bra{y}.
    \end{align}
    The constraint given by equation~\eqref{eq:constraintonB} gives us 
    \begin{align}
        [\ket{1}\bra{1}_{T-3} , B ] = \sum_{y \in \mathrm{S}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{(T-2)}}b_{1^{T-2}, y}\ket{1^{T-2}}\bra{y} - \sum_{x \in \mathrm{S}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{(T-2)}}b_{x,1^{T-2}}\ket{x}\bra{1^{T-2}} = 0
    \end{align}
    which implies 
    \begin{align}
        \label{eq:constr1}
        b_{1^{T-2}, x} = b_{x, 1^{T-2}} = 0  \text{ for } x \in \mathrm{S}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{(T-2)} \text{ and } x \neq 1^{T-2}.
    \end{align}
    The constraint given by equation~\eqref{eq:constraintonB1} entails
    \begin{align}
        [\ket{0}\bra{0}_{T-1} , B ] &= \sum_{x_{<T-2} \in \mathrm{S}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{(T-3)}}\sum_{y \in \mathrm{S}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{(T-2)}}b_{0x_{< T-1}, y}\ket{0x_{<T-2}}\bra{y} - \sum_{y_{<T-2} \in \mathrm{S}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{(T-3)}}\sum_{x \in \mathrm{S}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{(T-2)}}b_{x,0y_{<T-2}}\ket{x}\bra{0y_{< T-2}} = 0,
    \end{align}
    where for the first equality we have used the fact that $x \in \mathrm{S}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{(t)}$ implies $x_{< t} \in \mathrm{S}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{(t-1)}$. The above equaiton implies 
    \begin{align}
        \label{eq:constr2}
        b_{0x,y} = b_{y, 0x} = 0 \text{ for } x \in \mathrm{S}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{(T-3)}, y \in \mathrm{S}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{(T-2)}, \text{ and } 0x \neq y.
    \end{align}
    Combining the constraints of equation~\eqref{eq:constr1} and~\eqref{eq:constr2} we find 
    \begin{align}
        b_{x,y} = 0 \text{ for } x,y \in \mathrm{S}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{(T-2)} \text{ and } x \neq y,
    \end{align}
    implying we can write $B$ as 
    \begin{align}
        B = \sum_{s \in \mathrm{S}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{(T-2)}} b_{s} \ket{s}\bra{s}.
    \end{align}

    The next case we consider fixes $x = 100$ and $y=110$. Calculating our commutator and applying or constraint of equation~\eqref{eq:requirement3} we find
    \begin{align}
        \left[\frac{1}{2}\ket{100}\bra{110}_{T-1,T-2,T-3}, A\right] &= \frac{1}{2}\left[\ket{100}\bra{110}_{T-1,T-2,T-3}, \ket{10}\bra{10}_{T-1,T-2}\otimes B\right] + \frac{c}{2}\ket{1}\bra{1}_{T-1} \otimes \left[\ket{00}\bra{10}_{T-2,T-3},  P_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{(T-j)}\right] \nonumber \\
                                                                  &= -\frac{1}{2}\ket{10}\bra{11}_{T-1,T-2} \otimes (B\ket{0}\bra{0}_{T-3}) + \frac{c}{2}\ket{100}\bra{110}_{T-1,T-2,T-3} \nonumber \\
                                                                  & \quad - \frac{c}{2}\ket{1}\bra{1}_{T-1}\otimes (P_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{(T-1)}\ket{00}\bra{10}_{T-2,T-3}) \nonumber \\
                                                                  &= -\frac{1}{2}\ket{10}\bra{11}_{T-1,T-2} \otimes (B\ket{0}\bra{0}_{T-3}) + \frac{c}{2}\ket{100}\bra{110}_{T-1,T-2,T-3} \nonumber \\
                                                                  & \quad - \frac{c}{2}\ket{1}\bra{1}_{T-1}\otimes \sum_{s\in\{0,1\}^{T-3}}\left(P_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{(T-1)}\ket{00s}\bra{10s}\right) \nonumber \\
                                                                  &= -\frac{1}{2}\ket{10}\bra{11}_{T-1,T-2} \otimes (B\ket{0}\bra{0}_{T-3}) + \frac{c}{2}\ket{100}\bra{110}_{T-1,T-2,T-3}\otimes(\mathbb{I}^{(T-3)}  -  P_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{(T-3)}) \nonumber \\
                                                                  &= -\frac{1}{2}\ket{10}\bra{11}_{T-1,T-2} \otimes (B\ket{0}\bra{0}_{T-3}) + \frac{c}{2}\ket{100}\bra{110}_{T-1,T-2,T-3}\otimes P_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{(T-3)} \nonumber \\
                                                                  &= -\frac{1}{2}\ket{10}\bra{11}_{T-1,T-2} \otimes \sum_{ s \in \mathrm{S}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{(T-3)}} b_{0s}\ket{0s}\bra{0s} + \frac{c}{2}\ket{100}\bra{110}_{T-1,T-2,T-3}\otimes P_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{(T-3)} \nonumber \\
                                                                  &= -\frac{1}{2}\ket{100}\bra{110}_{T-1,T-2, T-3} \otimes \sum_{s \in \mathrm{S}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{(T-3)}} b_{0s}\ket{s}\bra{s} + \frac{c}{2}\ket{100}\bra{110}_{T-1,T-2,T-3}\otimes P_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{(T-3)} \nonumber \\
                                                                  &= 0.
    \end{align}
    The above equation implies
    \begin{equation}
        b_{0s} = c \text{ for } s \in \mathrm{S}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{(T-3)}
    \end{equation}
    Therefore $B$ simplifies to become 
    \begin{equation}
        B =  b_{1^{T-2}} \ket{1^{T-2}}\bra{1^{T-2}} + c \ket{0}\bra{0}_{T-3} \otimes P_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{(T-3)}.
    \end{equation}

    Consider the final case of $x=110$ and $y=101$. We find 
    \begin{align}
        \left[\frac{1}{2}\ket{110}\bra{101}_{T-1,T-2,T-3}, A \right] &= \frac{1}{2}\left[\ket{110}\bra{101}_{T-1,T-2,T-3}, \ket{10}\bra{10}_{T-1,T-2} \otimes B\right] \nonumber \\
        & \quad + \frac{1}{2}\left[\ket{110}\bra{101}_{T-1,T-2,T-3}, C_{T-1}\otimes P_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{(T-1)}\right] \nonumber \\
                                                                   &= \frac{1}{2}\ket{11}\bra{10}_{T-1,T-2} \otimes\left(\ket{0}\bra{1}_{T-3} B\right)  + \frac{c}{2}\ket{1}\bra{1}_{T-1} \otimes \left[\ket{10}\bra{01}_{T-2,T-3}, P_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{(T-1)}\right] \nonumber \\
                                                                   &= \frac{b_{1^{T-2}}}{2} \otimes\ket{1101^{T-3}}\bra{101^{T-2}} \nonumber \\
                                                                   &\quad + \frac{c}{2}\ket{1}\bra{1}_{T-1} \otimes \left(\ket{10}\bra{01}_{T-2,T-3} P_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{(T-1)} - P_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{(T-1)}\ket{10}\bra{01}_{T-2,T-3} \right) \nonumber \\
                                                                   &= \frac{b_{1^{T-2}}}{2} \otimes\ket{1101^{T-3}}\bra{101^{T-2}} \nonumber \\
                                                                   & \quad + \frac{c}{2}\ket{1}\bra{1}_{T-1} \otimes \left(\sum_{s\in\{0,1\}^{T-3}}\ket{10s}\bra{01s} P_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{(T-1)} - \ket{10}\bra{01}_{T-2,T-3} \right) \nonumber \\
                                                                   &= \frac{b_{1^{T-2}}}{2} \otimes\ket{1101^{T-3}}\bra{101^{T-2}} + \frac{c}{2}\ket{1}\bra{1}_{T-1} \otimes \left(\sum_{s\in\{0,1\}^{T-3} \setminus \{1^{T-3}\}}\ket{10s}\bra{01s}  - \ket{10}\bra{01}_{T-2,T-3} \right) \nonumber \\
                                                                   &= \frac{b_{1^{T-2}}}{2} \otimes\ket{1101^{T-3}}\bra{101^{T-2}} - \frac{c}{2} \ket{1101^{T-3}}\bra{101^{T-2}} = 0
    \end{align} 
    which implies $b_{1^{T-2}} = c$. Thus we find 
    \begin{equation}
        B =  c\left( \ket{1^{T-2}}\bra{1^{T-2}} +  \ket{0}\bra{0}_{T-3} \otimes P_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{(T-3)}\right)
    \end{equation}
    implying 
    \begin{align}
        A = \ket{10}\bra{10}_{T-1,T-2} \otimes B + C \otimes P_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{(T-1)} &= c \left(\ket{101^{T-2}}\bra{101^{T-2}} +  \ket{100}\bra{100}_{T-1,T-2,T-3} \otimes P_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{(T-3)} + \mathbb{I}_{T-1} \otimes P_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{(T-1)} \right) \nonumber \\
                                                                          &= c \left(\ket{10}\bra{10}_{T-1,T-2} \otimes P_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{(T-2)} + \mathbb{I}_{T-1} \otimes P_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{(T-1)} \right) = c P_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{(T)}.
    \end{align}

    Therefore for all $A \in \ker{\operatorname{\mathcal{D}}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}^{(T-1,T-2, T-3)}|_{\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{(T)})}} \cap \mathcal{P}_{\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{(T)})}\left[\mathbb{V}\right]$ , 
    \begin{equation}
        A = c P_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{(T)}
    \end{equation}
    for some $c \in \mathbb{C}$ implying 
    \begin{equation}
        \ker{\operatorname{\mathcal{D}}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}^{(T-1,T-2, T-3)}|_{\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{(T)})}} \cap \mathcal{P}_{\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{(T)})}\left[\mathbb{V}\right] = P_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{(T)}
    \end{equation}
    as stated.
<!-- end proof-46 -->
<!-- proposition--3: body_md -->
Let $\operatorname{\mathcal{D}}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{unary}}}$ be the Lindbladian dissipator defined according to equation~\eqref{eq:Dunary} of Definition~\ref{def:localDQCSAT} and $P_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{(T)}$ be the projection onto $\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{(T)}$ with $\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{(T)}$ and $\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{(T)}$ defined according to equation~\eqref{eq:globalillandlegsubspaces} , then 
    \begin{equation}
        \ker{\operatorname{\mathcal{D}}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{unary}}}} = \mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{MA}) \otimes \left(\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{(T)}) \oplus P_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{(T)}\right).
    \end{equation}
<!-- end proposition--3 -->
<!-- proof-47: body_md -->
Since $\operatorname{\mathcal{D}}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{unary}}}$ only acts non-trivially on the clock register $C$ it suffices to restrict $\operatorname{\mathcal{D}}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{unary}}}$ to $\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{C})$ and show 
    \begin{equation}
        \label{eq:inducthyp}
        \ker{\operatorname{\mathcal{D}}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{unary}}}|_{\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{C})}} = \mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{(T)}) \oplus P_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{(T)}
    \end{equation}
    We proceed via induction. Consider the base case of $T=3$, from equation~\eqref{eq:Dunary} of Definition~\ref{def:localDQCSAT} we have 
    \begin{equation}
        \operatorname{\mathcal{D}}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{unary}}}|_{\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{C})}(\bullet) = \operatorname{\mathcal{D}}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}^{(2,1,0)}(\bullet) =  \sum_{(x, y) \in \mathrm{S}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}} \times 2}} \left(\frac{1}{4}\ket{x}\bra{y}\bullet\ket{y}\bra{x} - \frac{1}{8}\left\{\ket{y}\bra{y}, \bullet\right\}\right)
    \end{equation}
    where $S_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}$ is defined according to equation~\eqref{eq:localillandlegstrings}. Applying Lemma~\ref{lm:DuKerbasecase} we find our base case holds.

    We now proceed to proving the inductive step. Assume the statement of equation~\eqref{eq:inducthyp} holds for all $T \geq 3$. For a clock register $C$ of size $T+1$ we find from equation~\eqref{eq:Dunary} of Definition~\ref{def:localDQCSAT} 
    \begin{equation}
        \operatorname{\mathcal{D}}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{unary}}}|_{\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{C})} =  \operatorname{\mathcal{D}}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}^{(T, T-1, T-2)} + \sum_{t=0}^{T-3}\operatorname{\mathcal{D}}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}^{(t+2, t+1, t)} = \operatorname{\mathcal{D}}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}^{(T, T-1, T-2)} + \operatorname{\mathcal{D}}^{(T)},
    \end{equation}
    where we have defined $\operatorname{\mathcal{D}}^{(T)} = \sum_{t=0}^{T-3}\operatorname{\mathcal{D}}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}^{(t+2, t+1, t)}$. Since both $\operatorname{\mathcal{D}}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}^{(T, T-1, T-2)}$ and $\operatorname{\mathcal{D}}^{(T)}$ are valid Lindbladian dissipators acting on $\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{C})$ and are Hermitian with respect to the Hilbert-Schmidt inner product, we have $\operatorname{\mathcal{D}}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}^{(T, T-1, T-2)}, \operatorname{\mathcal{D}}^{(T)} \preceq 0$ implying 
    \begin{equation}
        \ker{\operatorname{\mathcal{D}}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{unary}}}|_{\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{C})}} =  \ker{\operatorname{\mathcal{D}}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}^{(T, T-1, T-2)}} \cap \ker{\operatorname{\mathcal{D}}^{(T)}}.
    \end{equation}
    Note, $\operatorname{\mathcal{D}}^{(T)}$ is simply $\operatorname{\mathcal{D}}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{unary}}}|_{\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{C})}$ with a clock register of size $T$ acting on a register of size $T+1$. Therefore applying our induction hypothesis to the above equation we find
    \begin{equation}
        \ker{\operatorname{\mathcal{D}}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{unary}}}|_{\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{C})}} = \ker{\operatorname{\mathcal{D}}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}^{(T, T-1, T-2)}} \cap \left[\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{T}) \otimes \left(\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{(T)}) \oplus P_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{(T)}\right)\right].
    \end{equation}
    Lemma~\ref{lm:helper1} implies $\ker{\operatorname{\mathcal{D}}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}^{(T,T-1,T-2)}} = \mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{(T+1)}) \oplus \ker{\operatorname{\mathcal{D}}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}^{(T,T-1,T-2)}|_{\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{(T+1)})^{\perp}}}$ allowing us to write
    \begin{equation}
        \label{eq:inductivestepapplied}
        \ker{\operatorname{\mathcal{D}}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{unary}}}|_{\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{C})}} = \left(\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{(T+1)}) \oplus \ker{\operatorname{\mathcal{D}}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}^{(T,T-1,T-2)}|_{\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{(T+1)})^{\perp}}}\right)
         \cap \left[\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{T}) \otimes \left(\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{(T)}) \oplus P_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{(T)}\right)\right].
    \end{equation}
    Since $\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{(T+1)}) \subseteq \mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{T}) \otimes \mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{(T)})$ we can apply the modular law to equation~\eqref{eq:inductivestepapplied} giving us
    \begin{align}
        \label{eq:inductionstep1}
        \ker{\operatorname{\mathcal{D}}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{unary}}}|_{\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{C})}} = \mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{(T+1)}) \oplus \left(\ker{\operatorname{\mathcal{D}}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}^{(T,T-1,T-2)}|_{\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{(T+1)})^{\perp}}} \cap \mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{T}) \otimes \left(\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}^{(T)}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}) \oplus P_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{(T)}\right)\right).
    \end{align}
    Defining $\mathbb{V} = \mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{T}) \otimes \left(\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}^{(T)}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}) \oplus P_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{(T)}\right)$ and applying our block characterization of $\operatorname{\mathcal{D}}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}^{(T,T-1,T-2)}$ given in Lemma~\ref{lm:helper1} we find
    \begin{align}
        \label{eq:compofinduction}
        \ker{\operatorname{\mathcal{D}}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}^{(T,T-1,T-2)}|_{\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{(T+1)})^{\perp}}} \cap \mathbb{V} = \Big(&\ker{\operatorname{\mathcal{D}}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}^{(T,T-1,T-2)}|_{\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{(T+1)}, \mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{(T+1)})}} \oplus \ker{\operatorname{\mathcal{D}}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}^{(T,T-1,T-2)}|_{\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{(T+1)}, \mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{(T+1)})}} \nonumber \\
                                                                                                                  &\oplus \ker{\operatorname{\mathcal{D}}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}^{(T,T-1,T-2)}|_{\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{(T+1)})}}\Big) \cap \mathbb{V}
    \end{align}
    In order to distribute the intersection we compute $\mathcal{P}_{\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{(T+1)}, \mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{(T+1)})}\left[\mathbb{V}\right]$, $\mathcal{P}_{\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{(T+1)}, \mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{(T+1)})}\left[\mathbb{V}\right]$, and $\mathcal{P}_{\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{(T+1)})}\left[\mathbb{V}\right]$. We find
    \begin{align}
        \mathcal{P}_{\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{(T+1)}, \mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{(T+1)})}\left[\mathbb{V}\right] &= \mathcal{P}_{\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{(T+1)}, \mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{(T+1)})}\left[\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{T}) \otimes \mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{(T)})\right] \\
                                                                                                                   &= \mathcal{P}_{\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{(T+1)}, \mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{(T+1)})}\left[\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{T}) \otimes \mathcal{B}(\ket{1^{T}} \oplus \ket{0}_{T-1} \otimes \mathcal{H}^{(T-1)}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}})\right] \nonumber \\
                                                                                                                     &= \mathcal{P}_{\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{(T+1)}, \mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{(T+1)})}\left[\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{T}) \otimes \ket{1^{T}}\bra{1^{T}}\right] \oplus \mathcal{P}_{\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{(T+1)}, \mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{(T+1)})}\left[\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{T})\otimes \mathcal{B}(\ket{1^{T}}, \ket{0}_{T-1}\otimes\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{(T-1)}) \right] \nonumber \\
                                                                                                                       &\quad \oplus \mathcal{P}_{\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{(T+1)}, \mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{(T+1)})}\left[\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{T})\otimes \mathcal{B}(\ket{0}_{T-1}\otimes\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{(T-1)}, \ket{1^{T}} )\right] \nonumber \\
                                                                                                                         &\quad \oplus \mathcal{P}_{\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{(T+1)}, \mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{(T+1)})}\left[\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{T})\otimes \mathcal{B}(\ket{0}_{T-1}\otimes\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{(T-1)})\right] \nonumber \\
                                                                                                                     &= \mathcal{P}_{\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{(T+1)}, \mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{(T+1)})}\left[\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{T})\otimes \mathcal{B}(\ket{0}_{T-1}\otimes\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{(T-1)}, \ket{1^{T}} )\right] \nonumber \\
                                                                                                                         &\quad \oplus \mathcal{P}_{\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{(T+1)}, \mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{(T+1)})}\left[\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{T})\otimes \mathcal{B}(\ket{0}_{T-1}\otimes\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{(T-1)})\right] \nonumber \\
                                                                                                                           &= \mathcal{B}(\ket{10}_{T,T-1}\otimes\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{(T-1)}, \ket{01^{T}} )\oplus  \mathcal{B}(\ket{10}_{T,T-1}\otimes\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{(T-1)}, \ket{1^{T+1}} )  \nonumber \\
                                                                                                                             &\quad \oplus \mathcal{B}(\ket{10}_{T,T-1}\otimes\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{(T-1)}, \ket{00}_{T,T-1}\otimes\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{(T-1)}) \nonumber \\
                                                                                                                               &= \mathcal{B}(\ket{10}_{T,T-1}\otimes\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{(T-1)}, \mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{(T+1)} ) \subseteq \mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{T})\otimes \mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{(T)}) \subseteq \mathbb{V}
    \end{align}
    Through a similar calculation we find
    \begin{align}
        \mathcal{P}_{\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{(T+1)}, \mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{(T+1)})}\left[\mathbb{V}\right] &= \mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{(T+1)}, \ket{10}_{T,T-1}\otimes\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{(T-1)}) \subseteq \mathbb{V},
    \end{align}
    and
    \begin{align}
        \label{eq:billegalsubspace}
        \mathcal{P}_{\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{(T+1)})}\left[\mathbb{V}\right] &= \mathcal{P}_{\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{(T+1)})}\left[\ket{1}\bra{1}_{T} \otimes \mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{(T)})\right] \oplus \mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{T})\otimes P_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{(T)} \nonumber \\
                                                                                     &= \mathcal{B}(\ket{10}_{T,T-1} \otimes \mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{(T-1)}) \oplus \mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{T})\otimes P_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{(T)} \subseteq \mathbb{V}.
    \end{align}
    Thus we can distribute the intersection in equation~\eqref{eq:compofinduction} giving us
    \begin{align}
        \label{eq:compofinduction1}
        \ker{\operatorname{\mathcal{D}}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}^{(T,T-1,T-2)}|_{\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{(T+1)})^{\perp}}} \cap \mathbb{V} = &\left(\ker{\operatorname{\mathcal{D}}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}^{(T,T-1,T-2)}|_{\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{(T+1)}, \mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{(T+1)})}} \cap \mathcal{P}_{\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{(T+1)}, \mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{(T+1)})}\left[\mathbb{V}\right] \right) \nonumber \\
                                                                                                             &\oplus \left(\ker{\operatorname{\mathcal{D}}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}^{(T,T-1,T-2)}|_{\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{(T+1)}, \mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{(T+1)})}} \cap \mathcal{P}_{\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{(T+1)}, \mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{(T+1)})}\left[\mathbb{V}\right]\right) \nonumber \\
                                                                                                               &\oplus \left(\ker{\operatorname{\mathcal{D}}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}^{(T,T-1,T-2)}|_{\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{(T+1)})}} \cap \mathcal{P}_{\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{(T+1)})}\left[\mathbb{V}\right]\right)
    \end{align}
    We proceed to break down each of the terms in the direct sum given above.

    Consider the first term in our direct sum of equation~\eqref{eq:compofinduction1}. Let
    \begin{equation}
        A \in \mathcal{P}_{\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{(T+1)}, \mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{(T+1)})}\left[\mathbb{V}\right] = \mathcal{B}(\ket{10}_{T,T-1}\otimes\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{(T-1)}, \mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{(T+1)}).
    \end{equation}
    Thus we can write
    \begin{equation}
        A = \sum_{s \in \mathrm{S}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{(T-1)}}\sum_{x \in \mathrm{S}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{(T+1)}}a_{sx}\ket{10s}\bra{x}.
    \end{equation}
    For $A$ to be in $\ker{\operatorname{\mathcal{D}}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}^{(T,T-1,T-2)}|_{\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{(T+1)}, \mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{(T+1)})}}  \cap \mathcal{P}_{\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{(T+1)}, \mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{(T+1)})}\left[\mathbb{V}\right]$ we require
    \begin{equation}
        \label{eq:requirement1}
        \operatorname{\mathcal{D}}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}^{(T,T-1,T-2)}|_{\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{(T+1)}, \mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{(T+1)})}(A) = 0.
    \end{equation}
    We can calculate 
    \begin{align}
        \operatorname{\mathcal{D}}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}^{(T,T-1,T-2)}|_{\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{(T+1)}, \mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{(T+1)})}(A) &= -\frac{1}{2}\left[P_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}\right]_{T,T-1,T-2}A \nonumber \\
                                                                                                            &= -\frac{1}{2}\sum_{s \in \mathrm{S}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{(T-1)}}\sum_{x \in \mathrm{S}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{(T+1)}}a_{sx}\left[P_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}\right]_{T,T-1,T-2}\ket{10s}\bra{x} = -\frac{1}{2}A ,
    \end{align}
    implying $A = 0$ if we require equation~\eqref{eq:requirement1}. Thus we find
    \begin{equation}
        \label{eq:zeropart}
        \ker{\operatorname{\mathcal{D}}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}^{(T,T-1,T-2)}|_{\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{(T+1)}, \mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{(T+1)})}}  \cap \mathcal{P}_{\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{(T+1)}, \mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{(T+1)})}\left[\mathbb{V}\right] =  \{0\}.
    \end{equation}

    Similarly for the second term in our direct sum of equation~\eqref{eq:compofinduction1}, let
    \begin{equation}
        A \in \mathcal{P}_{\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{(T+1)}, \mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{(T+1)})}\left[\mathbb{V}\right] = \mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{(T+1)}, \ket{10}_{T,T-1}\otimes\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{(T-1)}).
    \end{equation}
    implying we can write
    \begin{equation}
        A = \sum_{s \in \mathrm{S}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{(T-1)}}\sum_{x \in \mathrm{S}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{(T+1)}}a_{xs}\ket{x}\bra{10s}.
    \end{equation}
    For $A$ to be in $\ker{\operatorname{\mathcal{D}}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}^{(T,T-1,T-2)}|_{\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{(T+1)}, \mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{(T+1)})}}  \cap \mathcal{P}_{\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{(T+1)}, \mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{(T+1)})}\left[\mathbb{V}\right]$ we require
    \begin{equation}
        \label{eq:requirement2}
        \operatorname{\mathcal{D}}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}^{(T,T-1,T-2)}|_{\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{(T+1)}, \mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{(T+1)})}(A) = 0.
    \end{equation}
    We can calculate 
    \begin{align}
        \operatorname{\mathcal{D}}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}^{(T,T-1,T-2)}|_{\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{(T+1)}, \mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{(T+1)})}(A) &= -\frac{1}{2}A\left[P_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}\right]_{T,T-1,T-2} \nonumber \\
                                                                                                            &= -\frac{1}{2}\sum_{s \in \mathrm{S}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{(T-1)}}\sum_{x \in \mathrm{S}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{(T+1)}}a_{xs}\ket{x}\bra{10s}\left[P_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}\right]_{T,T-1,T-2} = -\frac{1}{2}A ,
    \end{align}
    implying $A = 0$ if we require equation~\eqref{eq:requirement2}. Thus we find
    \begin{equation}
        \label{eq:zeropart1}
        \ker{\operatorname{\mathcal{D}}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}^{(T,T-1,T-2)}|_{\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{(T+1)}, \mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{(T+1)})}}  \cap \mathcal{P}_{\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{(T+1)}, \mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{(T+1)})}\left[\mathbb{V}\right] =  \{0\}.
    \end{equation}

    Applying equations~\eqref{eq:zeropart} and~\eqref{eq:zeropart1} to equation~\eqref{eq:compofinduction1} we find
    \begin{align}
        \ker{\operatorname{\mathcal{D}}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}^{(T,T-1,T-2)}|_{\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{(T+1)})^{\perp}}} \cap \mathbb{V} = \ker{\operatorname{\mathcal{D}}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}^{(T,T-1,T-2)}|_{\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{(T+1)})}} \cap \mathcal{P}_{\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{(T+1)})}\left[\mathbb{V}\right].
    \end{align}
    Thus our induction step becomes
    \begin{align}
        \label{eq:inductionstep2}
        \ker{\operatorname{\mathcal{D}}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{unary}}}|_{\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{C})}} = \mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{(T+1)}) \oplus \left(\ker{\operatorname{\mathcal{D}}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}^{(T,T-1,T-2)}|_{\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{(T+1)})}} \cap \mathcal{P}_{\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{(T+1)})}\left[\mathbb{V}\right]\right).
    \end{align}
    Applying Lemma~\ref{lm:helper2} we find 
    \begin{align}
        \ker{\operatorname{\mathcal{D}}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{unary}}}|_{\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{C})}} = \mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}^{(T+1)}) \oplus P_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{(T+1)}
    \end{align}
    implying our induction hypothesis holds for $T \geq 3$ which suffices to prove the statement.
<!-- end proof-47 -->
<!-- lemma-30: body_md -->
\label{lm:Dublockdiag}
    Let $\operatorname{\mathcal{D}}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{unary}}}$ be the Lindbladian dissipator defined according to equation~\eqref{eq:Dunary} of Definition~\ref{def:localDQCSAT} and subspaces $\mathbb{O}$, $\mathbb{D}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}$, and $\mathbb{D}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}$ be defined according to equation~\eqref{eq:subspacedefs} then
    \begin{equation}
        \operatorname{\mathcal{D}}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{unary}}}|_{\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{C})} = \operatorname{\mathcal{D}}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{unary}}}|_{\mathbb{D}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}} \oplus \operatorname{\mathcal{D}}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{unary}}}|_{\mathbb{D}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}}  \oplus \operatorname{\mathcal{D}}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{unary}}}|_{\mathbb{O}}.
    \end{equation}
<!-- end lemma-30 -->
<!-- proof-48: body_md -->
Define $\mathbb{D} = \mathbb{D}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}} \oplus \mathbb{D}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}$. We first show that $\operatorname{\mathcal{D}}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{unary}}}|_{\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{C})}$ admits $\mathbb{D}$ and $\mathbb{O}$ as invariant subspaces implying $\operatorname{\mathcal{D}}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{unary}}}|_{\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{C})}$ block diagonalizes across the decomposition $\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{C}) = \mathbb{D} \oplus \mathbb{O}$. Subsequently we show that $\operatorname{\mathcal{D}}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{unary}}}|_{\mathbb{D}}$ admits $\mathbb{D}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}$ and $\mathbb{D}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{legal}}}$ as invariant subspaces thus implying the statement.

    Let $A \in \mathbb{D}$, computing the action of $\operatorname{\mathcal{D}}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{unary}}}|_{\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{C})}$ on $A$ we find
    \begin{align}
        \operatorname{\mathcal{D}}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{unary}}}|_{\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{C})}(A) &= \sum_{x \in \{0,1\}^{T}}a_{x}\operatorname{\mathcal{D}}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{unary}}}|_{\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{C})}(\ket{x}\bra{x})  = \sum_{t=0}^{T-3}\sum_{x \in \{0,1\}^{T}}a_{x}\operatorname{\mathcal{D}}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}^{(t+2,t+1,t)}(\ket{x}\bra{x}) \nonumber \\
        &= \sum_{t=0}^{T-3}\sum_{x \in \{0,1\}^{T}}a_{x}\ket{x_{>t+2}}\bra{x_{>t+2}}\otimes \operatorname{\mathcal{D}}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}(\ket{x_{t+2}x_{t+1}x_{t}}\bra{x_{t+2}x_{t+1}x_{t}})\otimes \ket{x_{<t}}\bra{x_{<t}}.
    \end{align}
    Since 
    \begin{equation}
        \operatorname{\mathcal{D}}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}(\ket{s}\bra{s}) = \begin{cases}
            \frac{P_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}}{4} - \ket{s}\bra{s} \text{ for } s \in \mathrm{S}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}} \\
            0 \text{ otherwise }
        \end{cases},
    \end{equation}
    if we define the set of indices $\tau(x) \subseteq \{0, 1, \cdots T-3\}$ such that $t \in \tau(x)$ implies $x_{t+2}x_{t+1}x_{t} \in \mathrm{S}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}$ then we write 
    \begin{align}
        \operatorname{\mathcal{D}}_{\operatorname{\mathrm{unary}}}|_{\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_{C})}(A) &= \sum_{x \in \{0,1\}^{T}}a_{x}\sum_{t \in \tau(x)}\left(\frac{1}{4}\ket{x_{>t+2}}\bra{x_{>t+2}}\otimes [P_{\operatorname{\mathrm{illegal}}}^{\operatorname{\mathrm{loc}}}]_{t+2,t+1,t} \otimes \ket{x_{<t}}\bra{x_{<t}} - \ket{x}\bra{x}\right).
    \end{align}
    Since for all $t \in \{0, 1, \cdots, T-3\}$,
    \begin{align}
